_comment: Which forge-cli release contains each pull request a docs page cites.
Read by the release-marker sweep in scripts/check_cli_docs.py. A page may
call a pull request unreleased only while that pull request is absent from
releaseOfPr; once an entry exists here, every `unreleased` marker naming it
fails CI, with the file, the line and the release that contains it.
Regenerate from a forge-cli checkout, which needs no network:
It reads CHANGELOG.md for the release list, finds each release's
`chore(release)` commit on the default branch, and asks git whether the
pull request's merge commit is an ancestor of it. Nothing is inferred from
a date: a release cut on the same day as a merge is decided by ancestry.
reviewedThroughRelease is the newest forge-cli release these entries were
checked against. When forge-cli has cut a newer one and a page still calls
some pull request unreleased, the sweep fails: that release may contain it
and nobody has looked. Refresh this file and the markers together.
